root_causes.LAYOUT: The phase-world artifact locations (C summary, per-phase bank, A-phase generation failures, learn ledgers) are aligned onto the canonical names by v4_layout -- the alignment itself is the disclosure; these paths never reach the comparators.
root_causes.R6_STRONG_ONLY_ADD_PATH: Repair plan R6 (docs/decisions/execute_learn_repair_plan_20261016.md): the add path's evidence is the D phase's STRONG trajectories only -- the weak arm's diagnose skills of the 69904f7 world have no phase-world producer, so the bank is smaller and everything derived from it differs (E1/E2 rows, leak verdicts, retrieval categories, every E4 call embedding a skills listing, the G10/G11 work per group, the injection token counts).
root_causes.R8_EXAM_GENERATION_IN_A: The R8 ruling moved exam generation into the A phase; the live sequence has no A phase, so its EXAM_GEN calls are gone (whitelist 1, pre-registered).
root_causes.R9_LABELS: R9's pNN phase labels: control_source is '<phase>_reuse' (D_reuse) where the stage world wrote 'stage1_reuse'; the alias table canonicalises both.
root_causes.W2B_LEARN_LEDGERS: W2-B replaced attributions.jsonl with the learn phase's task_list/revisions/outcomes ledgers; E6 compares the aligned (task, round, skill, version) traces, and the fields the ledgers no longer persist are disclosed at the comparator.

what: Wave 4 golden regeneration: the E1-E6 semantic comparison of the phase world's regenerated golden matrix against the archived 69904f7 baseline bundle. Red criteria are DISCLOSED differences with their complete enumerations; the standing test pins this file byte for byte, so any drift beyond (or a regression of) the disclosed set fails the suite.
